feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: Survival learning prioritizes cohort-specific NFKB1 associations in colorectal cancer
entry.summary: A study used penalized Cox models and CoxBoost to prioritize NFKB1 for retrospective colorectal-cancer survival analysis. Higher expression was associated with favorable survival in selected external cohorts, but the adjusted association was not significant in TCGA-COAD. Model discrimination was… (Discovery - Fujian Medical University Union Hospital; announced 2026-11-24)

entry.title: Video gait features and clinical models estimate lung function in a small cohort
entry.summary: A preprint used MediaPipe Pose to extract walking features and compared 13 regressors in 100 participants (33 classified with COPD). Five repeated 90/10 internal splits gave FEV1/FVC correlation 0.701±0.135 with gradient boosting and mid-expiratory-flow correlation 0.730±0.078 with histogram… (Discovery - Ondokuz Mayıs University; Samsun University; Duke University School of Medicine; University of Massachusetts Amherst; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: TyG-BMI adds modest discrimination in retrospective cardiovascular prediction
entry.summary: In 3,092 hypertensive CHARLS participants followed for a median eight years, a preprint compared learned cardiovascular-event predictors using baseline risk factors. Adding TyG-BMI increased reported AUC from 0.593 to 0.636; logistic regression performed best, with tree-based learners adding no… (Discovery - Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine; Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine; Heilongjiang University of Chinese Medicine; Shanxi University of Chinese Medicine; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Computer vision measures diverse tomato pollen responses to heat
entry.summary: A preprint fine-tuned CenterNet HourGlass104 to count and track pollen in approximately 300,000 time-lapse images from 218 tomato accessions and wild relatives. In vitro, raising temperature from 26°C to 34°C increased mean bursting at two hours from 14.9% to 83.1%, while tube-length responses… (Discovery - University of Arizona; Ohio State University; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Evolutionary optimization designs a simulated low-voltage photonic junction
entry.summary: A preprint used NSGA-II evolutionary optimization to vary doping-mask geometry and jointly reduce modulation voltage–length product and optical loss in a silicon microring junction. The resulting C-shaped profile reached a simulated VπL of about 0.39 V·cm, compared with 0.44–0.72 V·cm for… (Discovery - University of Florida; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Ensemble modeling explores OFD1 variant–phenotype associations retrospectively
entry.summary: A preprint combined random forest, XGBoost, RBF-SVM and elastic-net learners to model OFD1 phenotype groups from variant features. The 356-case clinical compilation included 61 new cases, but prediction used a much smaller missense subset plus 39 benign variants assigned phenotype-absent labels… (Discovery - Telethon Institute of Genetics and Medicine; University of Naples Federico II; Université Bourgogne Europe; University of Padua; Scuola Superiore Meridionale; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: MEG connectivity classifier shows limited lumbar-stenosis discrimination
entry.summary: A preprint evaluated subject-level MEG connectivity classifiers in 39 lumbar-stenosis patients and 31 controls. Random forest achieved mean nested-cross-validation AUC 0.723 with fold standard deviation 0.262, indicating substantial uncertainty and variation. SHAP identified features contributing… (Discovery - Beihang University; Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; Shandong First Medical University; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: MatterSim screening identifies low-conductivity lithium-metal candidates
entry.summary: A preprint used the MatterSim learned interatomic potential to calculate phonons for 42,347 stable, previously observed compounds and flag 11,176 with predicted phonon gaps larger than 1 THz. Screening and existing-database thermal descriptors prioritized lithium-metal binaries; targeted… (Discovery - University of Jyväskylä; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Cross-species classifier identifies a human dopaminergic subtype depleted in Parkinson’s disease
entry.summary: A hierarchical mixture-of-experts classifier transferred mouse dopaminergic-neuron labels to human single-nucleus datasets, identifying an Anxa1-associated population. The preprint reports this population was more depleted in Parkinson’s disease than comparator subtypes in a postmortem analysis of… (Discovery - Northwestern University; Shirley Ryan AbilityLab; Karolinska Institutet; University of California, San Diego; McGill University; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Grower-guided AI reduces nitrogen use in two wheat field pilots
entry.summary: A preprint coupled TabPFN nitrogen-response recommendations with Gemini 3 Pro schedule adjustments reviewed by an agronomist. In 2025–26 commercial field trials at two sites, treatments used 24.1% and 12.5% less nitrogen than standard practice, with no statistically significant yield differences… (Discovery - University of Sheffield; Zhejiang University of Technology; Harper Adams University; Velcourt Limited; Rothamsted Research; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Survival learning links a fibroblast signature to a tested KLF2–CD73 pathway
entry.summary: A preprint compared 45 survival-learning combinations in 439 colorectal-cancer training cases and selected a 17-gene LASSO signature including KLF2 and NT5E/CD73. Follow-on experiments using fibroblasts from three patients found that KLF2 overexpression reduced CD8 T-cell killing in co-culture… (Discovery - Hainan Medical University; Hainan General Hospital; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Learned lymphoma risk score shows retrospective associations and transport limits
entry.summary: CoxBoost plus a random survival forest produced a 16-gene DLBCL risk score after comparison of 101 model combinations. Reported validation C-indices were 0.613, 0.732 and 0.632, but those cohorts contributed to model selection. More strictly frozen preprocessing lowered discrimination to 0.547… (Discovery - Jinan University; You Jiang Medical University for Nationalities; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: CatBoost estimates six-month kidney-function category decline retrospectively
entry.summary: A preprint evaluated baseline clinical prediction of six-month eGFR-category worsening in 2,022 adults with diabetes and renal dysfunction. CatBoost was selected within development data and reached AUROC 0.91 in a reserved 405-patient internal test set. Inputs were restricted to baseline and… (Discovery - Shanghai Pudong Hospital; Fudan University; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: AlphaFold-guided tests link bacterial channel tails to temperature gating
entry.summary: A preprint combined AlphaFold2-Multimer predictions, molecular dynamics and electrophysiology to study a sodium channel from the marine bacterium Ruegeria pomeroyi. Predicted tail conformations suggested contacts that stabilize channel opening and reduce temperature sensitivity; targeted… (Discovery - University of Texas at Austin; Flatiron Institute; Max Planck Institute of Biophysics; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: Linear decoding distinguishes sound conditions in aging mouse cortex
entry.summary: A preprint reanalyzed auditory-cortex recordings and tested whether population activity distinguished silence, natural sounds and noise. In 33 mice with all three conditions recorded, a linear SVM achieved 82.50±8.74% mean accuracy using held-out time windows; template and linear-discriminant… (Discovery - University of Strathclyde; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc stores a different number for a BigDecimal outside the binary numeric range
entry.summary: Binary numeric conversion can silently store a different value when a BigDecimal exceeds the supported range; extreme scales can also consume processing time. The official CNA credits Anthropic OSS Scanner as finder and documents a fix in 42.7.15. Specific model, autonomy and case-specific… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc GSS connections can accept replayed replies and lose confidentiality
entry.summary: On connections that start GSS encryption, network replay can make an earlier reply accepted for a current query. Separately, an integrity-only packet from a party holding the session key can cause subsequent client SQL and parameters to be signed without encryption. Default connection settings do… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc does not enforce TLS for some ssl, service and DataSource settings
entry.summary: Some TLS-related connection settings are not enforced as requested, exposing traffic to an attacker on the network path under affected configurations. The official CNA credits Anthropic OSS Scanner as finder and documents a fix in 42.7.15. Specific model, autonomy and case-specific human-review… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc metadata queries can execute objects supplied by another database role
entry.summary: Unqualified catalog operators, functions and type names can resolve to another database role’s objects and run in the application session. Exploitation requires relevant database object-creation or temporary-object privileges and affected metadata/type operations. The official CVE credits… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc leaves a half-written message on the connection after an unchecked exception
entry.summary: An unchecked request exception can leave a partial protocol message buffered on a connection, allowing later uploaded value bytes to be interpreted as SQL. The official CNA credits Anthropic OSS Scanner as finder and documents a fix in 42.7.15. Specific model, autonomy and case-specific… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc simple-query parameter quoting can permit SQL injection
entry.summary: When non-default simple query mode is used with standard_conforming_strings disabled or changed, a string parameter can be interpreted as SQL under the application’s database role. Additional encoding-related variants require further configuration. The official CVE credits Anthropic OSS Scanner as… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)

entry.title: pgjdbc parses quoted text as SQL in JDBC escapes, dollar quotes and E strings
entry.summary: Quoted text can be misread by the query parser in affected JDBC escape, dollar-quote and escaped-string cases, allowing correctly quoted application content to run as SQL under the application database role. The official CNA credits Anthropic OSS Scanner as finder and documents a fix in 42.7.15.… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; pgjdbc maintainers; announced 2026-11-23)
